node-state-and-lifetime.text: As an operator, I need one live session and follower to remain the source of connection and confirmation state while a runner acts.

state-contracts.text: NodeSession, NodeMode, ExternalNode, Wallet and FundingFloor retain their constructors, fields and old facade path. No explicit session API or replacement for unsafePerformIO is introduced. The devnet node is bracketed and torn down with the session; an external node remains owned by its operator.
